messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need a crisp private-offer structure for the upcoming HW + Reserved Capacity bundle we plan to push to the cloud marketplaces. Goal is a repeatable play for SI co-sell and a clean renewal uplift.

matt: +1. Key constraints: SI deal flows expect simple SKUs, finance wants predictable committed revenue, and marketplace catalog limits number of line items.

jess: For clarity: are we thinking a single private offer SKU that combines HW credits + reserved compute, or a two-SKU bundle with an onboarding credit?

ana: Prefer a single offer from GTM POV, but it should break down on the invoice for partner margins. So catalog shows one bundle SKU, backend maps to two internal SKUs. Keeps marketplace listing simple.

oliver: Proposed pricing bands (rough draft):
- Commit band A: $100k/year => 18% discount vs list
- Band B: $250k/year => 25% discount + 3 months SW support credit
- Band C: $500k+ => 33% discount + 6 months SW support credit + priority onboarding
(These are blunt, we can refine)

harpreet: Addendum: requires minimum 12-month commit for Reserved Capacity. Renewal baseline = last 12 months consumed (post-optimization) + 10% uplift for retention incentive. If usage drops below 70% of commit, include a true-up clause.

matt: Two redlines from legal/finance: 1) ensure marketplace private offer has a contractor-friendly cancellation window (60 days) but with pro-rata clawback on credits; 2) define clear SKU mapping for partner margin calculation.

jess: For SI incentives — propose a one-time implementation credit that vests over 6 months tied to usage thresholds (e.g., 60% commit reached in first 3 months). That prevents churn gaming.

ana: Love that. Can we make implementation credit a non-billable line item in the private offer (marketplace accepts zeros for credits) but track it in our CRM for payout?

oliver: Yes. Implementation: marketplace-bot will create the private offer with two internal SKUs and a third internal credit SKU. Public catalog shows single bundle. We can attach hidden metadata: {"commit_band":"B","partner_tier":"silver"} so partner ops can auto-calc payouts.

marketplace-bot: Created draft private-offer id PO-2026-9402 (not published). Contains: bundle_sku RB-BUNDLE-2026, internal_skus [RB-HW-2026, RB-RES-2026], credit_sku RB-IMP-CREDIT-2026.

harpreet: Timeline ask from sales: need draft published to marketplace sandbox by EOD next Tue for SI enablement workshops. Any blockers?

matt: Blocker: pricing sign-off from finance and legal on the renewal uplift mechanics. I'll loop in finance and ask for a quick approval meeting tomorrow.

jess: I'll draft the SI payout matrix and onboarding acceptance criteria doc. Plan: share by Monday COB.

ana: Action list:
- matt -> schedule finance/legal quick sign-off (tomorrow)
- jess -> SI payout matrix + acceptance criteria (Mon COB)
- oliver -> finalize commit bands and hidden metadata mapping (Mon)
- harpreet -> confirm marketplace sandbox slot for publish (EOD Tue target)

matt: I'll also add a clear renewals play: auto-notify customer 90/60/30 days with projected true-up and recommended downsize options to avoid surprise charges. Need product to provide recommended downsize thresholds.

ana: Good call. Jess/Oliver, can product provide thresholds or heuristics we can bake into renewal messaging?

oliver: Product can provide heuristics by EOD Monday — based on 3-month rolling avg and forecasted growth band. Will add to the offer metadata.

harpreet: One more: include optional hardware trade-in credit for eligible customers at renewal (reduce new commit by up to 10% of HW residual value). That helps upgrade cycles for SI use cases.

jess: Sounds good. We'll add that as an optional SKU add-on with separate acceptance criteria.

ana: Perfect. If nobody objects, I'll call this ready-for-draft and we proceed to sandbox publish once finance/legal OK. Thanks team :rocket:

matt: No objections. Thanks all.

oliver: +1 :white_check_mark:

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled — private-offer PO-2026-9402 expires in 14 days if not published.
